## Part 3: how the premises are bound in the SRM11 instance theorems
seed, s : universally quantified binders `(seed : Nat → (String → Nat) → Env) (s : KState (KT n))`, linked only by `hrun : runModuleTG ... seed T' s = some envs`; nothing ties them to seedIn or to a Reset state.
machine run (Tools/ShippingSrm8Bridge.lean): the stream is `seedIn b ins`, the start state `⟨st0, mems, kids⟩` with `Reset raw D kids`, `st0 r = f.init` on the slot registers, inputs bounded `ins t x < 2 ^ declWidth b x`.
